Hello everyone,

I want to use repeated measure ANOVA for my thesis. I have completed a research for measuring the effects of Biological Soil Crusts (BSC) on some soil chemical (EC, pH, Na, K, Hco3, Cl, SAR, Soil moisture content) and physical (soil texture) parameters and some hydrological properties (such as runoff and sediment yield) in three seasons (spring, summer, and autumn).
here I want to use biological soil crust (BSC) (yes/no) as a fixed factor (here named as a Treatment), Season as a within-subject factor and functioning measurements (EC, pH, Na, K, Hco3, Cl, SAR, Soil moisture content, infiltration, runoff and sediment yield and soil texture) as a response variables.

aov.Infil <- aov(Infiltration~Treatment*Season+Error(Location),data=Dataset)#infiltration
summary(aov.Infil)
could you please help me for codes. are above codes correct?
